page_title: EVE 2-3 BOU | Everton v Bournemouth 31/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.

90+6' 2 - 3 Goal! Justin Kluivert swings the ball deep into the box and finds Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) unmarked, and his close-range header flies past the keeper into the right side of the goal. 2:3.

90+4' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) takes a brilliant touch after he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and strikes the ball to the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper dives low and saves his attempt.

90+3' What a save from Jordan Pickford! Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the top right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.

90+2' 2 - 2 Luis Sinisterra produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) rises high to head the ball into the left side of the goal and beyond the goalkeeper. He makes it 2:2.
90+2' The referee is firm and issues Tim Iroegbunam (Everton) a deserved yellow card.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Dwight McNeil.
88' Sean Dyche has decided to make a change. Beto (Everton) replaces Dominic Calvert-Lewin.
87' 2 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Dango Ouattara plays it into the box, and Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the bottom right corner. 2:1.
85' Corner kicks – 8:4.
83' Substitution. Iliman Ndiaye makes way for Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton).

83' What a chance that is! Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post.

82' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Jordan Pickford makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the left side of the goal.
82' Bournemouth have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

81' Adam Smith (Bournemouth) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The linesman makes the right call and Bournemouth will have a corner.

80' Tim Iroegbunam (Everton) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
80' Jack Harrison (Everton) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
77' Andoni Iraola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Adam Smith (Bournemouth) replacing Julian Araujo.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marcos Senesi departs the field of play to be replaced by Dean Huijsen (Bournemouth).
76' Michael Keane (Everton) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
76' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
75' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) commits a rough foul. Stuart Attwell stops the game and makes a call.
73' Good movement by Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
71' James Tarkowski (Everton) sees his header crash off the left post after meeting a corner kick inside the six-yard box. The goalkeeper would have been helpless.
71' The linesman referee is pointing towards the corner flag. It will be a corner kick.

70' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The referee points to the corner flag and Everton will take a corner.
66' Here is a change. Milos Kerkez is going off and Andoni Iraola gives the last tactical orders to Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth).
66' Andoni Iraola prepares a substitution. Ryan Christie is replaced by Alex Scott (Bournemouth).
65' Substitution. Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) in, Evanilson out.

65' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Kepa Arrizabalaga makes a great save to stop the effort going low into the middle of the goal.
65' Dwight McNeil (Everton) takes the corner which is cleared.
63' A dangerous looking corner kick from Dwight McNeil (Everton) is cleared to safety by the defence.

62' Dwight McNeil (Everton) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. The referee signals a corner kick to Everton.
60' Referee Stuart Attwell sees the trip by Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
57' 2 - 0 Goal! Dwight McNeil provides Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a strike into the middle of the goal. 2:0.
56' Dwight McNeil (Everton) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

55' Kepa Arrizabalaga pulls off a great save to deny Seamus Coleman (Everton) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the underside of the crossbar, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far! Everton force a corner. They send men into the box.
52' Bournemouth are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
50' 1 - 0 Goal! Michael Keane (Everton) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Dominic Calvert-Lewin, then sends the ball low into the middle of the net. 1:0.
50' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) tackles a bit over-zealously and Stuart Attwell blows for a foul.
49' The resulting set piece from Bournemouth is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
48' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. Bournemouth have a corner.
47' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' Total attempts – 4:4.
42' Jack Harrison (Everton) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

40' A cross from the corner kick arrives at the feet of Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth), giving him an opportunity to shoot. He misses completely, way over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
40' The ball is out of play and Bournemouth manage to earn a corner.
40' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bournemouth.
39' Tim Iroegbunam (Everton) tries to find Dominic Calvert-Lewin with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
37' Tim Iroegbunam (Everton) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Stuart Attwell signals.

35' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the free kick, took a good first touch and unleashed a powerful shot from mid-range which was stopped by one of the defenders.
33' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots goalwards, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Kepa Arrizabalaga. What a save!
32' Dwight McNeil (Everton) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
31' Julian Araujo (Bournemouth) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
30' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Everton was in an offside position.
28' Bournemouth force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

28' Evanilson (Bournemouth) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. The linesman points to the corner flag, Bournemouth are going to take it.
26' Evanilson (Bournemouth) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
23' Jordan Pickford (Everton) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
21' The referee awards a corner and Dwight McNeil (Everton) goes over to take it.
21' Tim Iroegbunam (Everton) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball. Everton will take a corner kick.
20' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
19' Everton seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
17' Jack Harrison (Everton) receives a pass and unleashes a shot which goes well wide of the right post.
15' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) runs onto a ball from Dwight McNeil and tries an ambitious shot from mid-range. The keeper has it covered but it goes just over the bar anyway.
14' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Evanilson (Bournemouth). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
14' Jack Harrison (Everton) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
13' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) times his run into the box beautifully and plants a good looking header at goal from the corner, but the ball flashes just wide of the left post.
12' Dwight McNeil (Everton) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
12' Dwight McNeil (Everton) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. Now Everton have a corner.
12' A quickly taken corner by Everton.
11' A cross into the box from Seamus Coleman (Everton) is cleared. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Everton.
10' A player from Bournemouth pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle.
9' Jack Harrison (Everton) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Dominic Calvert-Lewin.
7' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) latches onto a brilliant cross and fires the ball towards goal, but his shot goes high over the crossbar.
6' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
5' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
4' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) brings an opponent down and Stuart Attwell interrupts the game.
2' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
1' The first half has just begun.
Bournemouth will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Stuart Attwell.
